profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I've enjoyed being an IC and manager in Software Development, SRE / DevOps, and Test.

Other than paddleboarding and kayaking, I most enjoy helping small companies and teams grow, and building great products.

• Intrapreneurial mindset
• Insightful problem-solver and troubleshooter
• Strong communication and time-management
• Effective leader, skilled in leading teams and mentoring, technical product / project management
• Pragmatic agilist, leveraging Scrum, Kanban and XP approaches, in start-up / SMB environments

Languages, Technologies & Tools:

• Golang, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Java, C#, C++; Bash, Powershell; PostgreSQL, SingleStore, Snowflake, SQL Server; Docker, Kubernetes, EKS, Kustomize, Helm, ECS; Terraform, Ansible

• JUnit, NUnit, AWS, Azure; Git,; CircleCI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Harness, Jenkins; Artifactory

• Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Amplitude, MixPanel

(AWS, Terraform, Harness, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes / EKS, ECS, Docker, Lambda, DataDog, SumoLogic, Python, PostgreSQL)

positions.title: SRE / QE Manager
positions.description:
Managed and grew the DevOps / SRE, QE (Quality Engineering) teams. 

The DevOps / SRE team establishes and supports the tooling used by our development teams including CI / CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) automation, and Security policy automation.

The QE team designs and automates data-driven tests against our loan products.

positions.title: DevOps Container Architect
positions.description:
In-flight internet connectivity, IoT

Led projects to develop new airborne APIs, IoT functionality,  hosting via Docker Containers, to meet Gogo's expanding B2B business needs. Also played a key role in: Deployment automation, testability improvements; Process agility, release cycle efficiency / duration, agile adoption initiatives.

(Docker, Java, C/C++, Python, Linux, Jenkins, Ansible, Vagrant, AWS)
